[SWS_DM_00268] EcuReset positive response processing before reset
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04019
⌈
If the method
ara::diag::EcuResetRequest::RequestReset
did NOT raise
an
ApApplicationError
, the
Diagnostic Server instance
shall trigger re-
turn a positive response before the actual reset, in case the parameter
Diagnos-
ticEcuResetClass.respondToReset
is either not present or present and set to
DiagnosticResponseToEcuResetEnum.respondBeforeReset
.
⌋
